title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 7.10 The Binomial Distribution: Identify binomial experiments.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 7.10 The Binomial Distribution: Identify binomial experiments.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "7.10 The Binomial Distribution", prints these objectives: "Identify binomial experiments." "Use the binomial distribution to analyze binomial experiments.". The section text says: "It’s time for the World Series, which determines the champion for this season in Major League Baseball. The scrappy Los Angeles Angels are facing the powerhouse Cincinnati Reds. Computer models put the chances of the Reds winning any single game against the Angels at about 65%. The World Series, as its name implies, isn’t just one game, though: it’s what’s known as a “best-of-seven” contest: the teams play each other repeatedly until one team wins 4 games (which could take up to 7 games total…" This card reports that page.
